resources.string: Screen actions are waiting for the accessibility service. Open settings to reconnect it. This task has a total recovery wait of up to five minutes; you can stop it at any time.
Accessibility reconnected. The old screen observation was cleared; the agent must observe again before acting.
Recovery waiting timed out. No screen action was executed. Reconnect the service before continuing.
Recovery waiting ended. No pending screen action was replayed.
Unable to open settings. You can reconnect Nexus in the system accessibility settings.
